response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior full-stack/web software developer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and some systems-level DLang work, but the resume shows no evidence of SoC/IP modeling, computer architecture, GPU/accelerator work, deep-learning workload analysis, or hardware-software co-design — all core requirements for a Principal Performance Architect role focused on AI accelerator hardware. The experience profile is fundamentally mismatched with this specialized hardware performance role.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience with a CS degree, meeting general experience thresholds
Some low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (DLang microservices handling millions of requests/sec)
Brief exposure to C/C++ systems work and embedded/hardware-adjacent projects (National Instruments, robotic arms)
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, silicon performance modeling, or computer architecture experience whatsoever
No deep-learning training/inference optimization, GPU architecture, or SIMD/MIMD background
Career trajectory is web/product engineering, far from principal-level hardware performance architecture

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator / DL workload background
General seniority and systems programming exposure
